summary: Audit app-store discovery inputs and run bounded one-variable listing experiments with dated evidence, guardrails, and honest attribution limits.
triggers: An app listing needs a metadata, creative, localization, or discovery audit.
A store experiment needs one variable, a hypothesis, a baseline, metrics, and a stopping rule.
A growth report must separate observed marketplace behavior from ranking or conversion hypotheses.
antiTriggers: Promise ranking, conversion, review, or install outcomes from listing edits.
Change multiple high-impact fields without acknowledging attribution loss.
Report a prepared packet, competitor observation, or synthetic fixture as a published or validated store result.

provenance.note: Independent design grounded in the M source ledger: appeeky/aso-skills@4df730f456c21e42b9a2ea2be89fb32caf787728:skills/aso-audit/SKILL.md; dated listing inventory, field-level audit, bounded experiment design, and uncertainty reporting were integrated without copying source prose.
Beacon discovery, Prometheus measurement, Oracle investigation, and Muse localization routing informed optional relationships; no store publication or growth certification is claimed.
